text:
incident-bot: P1 - elevated 5xxs and latency for inference (eu-west-1). Auto-pager sent to @neha. War room: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (link pinned). Runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/inference-p1

neha: acked, I'm on pager. joining war room now :phone:

sam: joining. i'll pull recent tail of inference logs and k8s events.

maria: seeing spike in `model-proxy` 502s on host pool-eu-3. Not sure if upstream model crashed or routing issue.

jordan: checking autoscaler logs, queued jobs jumped ~3x. might be batching backlog.

alex: taking owner for mitigation and coordinating fallbacks. I'll test traffic shift to backup pool.

maria: notes: example errors from proxy: `ERROR upstream read: connection reset by peer` (repeated)

sam: grabbing KV cache metrics and prefix-hit rates. past 15m prefix-hit dropped 40%.

alex: action items
- alex: shift 20% traffic to eu-west-2 fallback (safe-cfg)
- neha: validate disk/io on pool-eu-3 hosts
- sam: collect model process core dumps / recent OOM logs
- maria: draft status page + customer note

neha: started disk checks on pool-eu-3, attaching commands I ran:
```
ssh node-03
sudo iotop -ao
journalctl -u model-proxy -n 200
```

maria: status page draft below — please quick review, I'll post after :eyes:
```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Inference requests for customers routed to EU region may see increased errors (502/503) and higher latency. A subset of requests will be retried automatically.
Scope: Multiple tenants in eu-west-1; no data exfiltration indicated.
Mitigation: Traffic is being shifted to a fallback pool and we are restarting affected proxy hosts. Engineers are actively investigating root cause.
Next update: in 30 minutes or sooner if we have a resolution.
```

jordan: looks good. add note: contact support if you see degraded SLA -> support@redwood.ai

alex: doing traffic shift now, will monitor error rate. tagging @sre-liaison for post-incident review assignment.

sre-liaison: thx — acknowledged. will collect timeline and schedule blameless postmortem after incident closes.

sam: uploaded logs to /shared/incidents/3298765432/ and pinned link in war room.

neha: disk/io checks ok so far, but model-proxy process CPU at 95% on node-03. restarting proxy on node-03 (graceful)

maria: once alex confirms error rate down, i'll post the status page update and the customer notification template (short email + in-app banner copy).

alex: error rate down ~65% after 20% shift. continuing to shift another 30% to fallback (observing latency).

maria: posting status now. customer notification draft: "We are investigating an issue causing increased errors for inference requests in EU region. We're actively mitigating and will update in 30 minutes."

neha: pager silence confirmed after restart on node-03. remaining hosts show degraded but stable CPU.

jordan: collecting metrics for post-incident: batch queue size, prefix-hit %, proxy cpu, model process restarts.

alex: handing off primary owner to @maria for comms and monitoring while i continue mitigation.

maria: taking owner for comms. will keep @alex and @neha looped for next updates. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Update posted to incident channel and status page at 3298765432. Next update scheduled +30m."
